project: VICE ATLAS — Universal Dossier / Ficha Redesign (SSS Tier)
design_tier: SSS Tier Obscuro / GTA Town x Rockstar Games hybrid

problem_analysis.current_issue: User reported that the current individual dossier/ficha page feels like a basic title with a large dark car-image letterbox block. It lacks high-impact tactical hierarchy, editorial depth, and holistic inspectability across different dossier types (Vehicles, Weapons, Characters/People, Regions, Radio, Media/Screenshots, Guides/Editorials, Videos).
core_imperatives: Keep all current data, attributes, checklist/bookmark persistence, spoiler protection, video playback, and links intact without inventing fake gameplay stats.
Universal real detail routes (never modals); real image inspectability without tiny letterboxed blocks.
Full SSS-tier visual direction: midnight base with tropical accents (--gta-pink, --gta-turquoise, --gta-coral, --gta-peach, --gta-lilac, --gta-cream).
Gradients marked on display headings, discrete on surfaces; selective borders, shadows, and underlines matching PRD approvals.
Remove generic AI copy; strictly respect factual labels ('GTABase · community reference', 'Rockstar Games · official', etc.).
Full responsiveness from 360px mobile up to 1920px ultrawide.

headings.treatment: Gradient fill (--gradient-heading / --gradient-sunset) with -webkit-background-clip: text; 0.35px fine stroke and glyph-following drop-shadow(0 2px 0 #080810b8) drop-shadow(0 8px 18px #080810b3)

dossier_redesign_blueprint.layout_mode: Hybrid Cinematic Stage + Modular Editorial Command Grid

structural_layers.description: Sticky micro-navigation bar at top of detail view with category badge, collection route, entry counter, and quick share/bookmark actions.

Massive full-bleed or contained cinematic viewport that adapts dynamically by item.kind (Vehicle showcase stage with radial spotlight and grid mesh, Character portrait duo-tone canvas, Region landscape panorama with coordinate tags, Media 1:1 inspectable light-box with zoom trigger, Video theater with custom poster & play aura). Eliminates the dead letterbox aesthetic by introducing illuminated ground reflections and ambient neon rim lighting.
inspectability_features: Interactive full-canvas view mode toggle ('Inspect Frame')
Aspect-ratio intelligent framing (contain with ambient glow for vehicles/weapons, cover/expand for regions/media)
Overlaid tactical watermark stamp ('VICE ATLAS DOSSIER // [ITEM_ID]')

structural_layers.description: Directly beneath or flanking the image stage: quick tactical badges (Classification, Manufacturer/Subcategory, Provenance Status, Local Checklist state, Quick Compare button).
components: Checklist toggle with instant local-device feedback
Share & Download buttons with tactile active states

structural_layers.description: Asymmetrical two-column or three-column bento architecture:

columns.primary_prose_column: Lead synopsis with drop-cap accent, multi-paragraph analysis, bulleted facts list styled as tactical surveillance points, spoiler protection shroud with neon eye reveal.
columns.secondary_dossier_sidebar: Sticky 'Source Dossier' technical file with origin URL, disclaimer card, structured attribute pairs with neon divider bars, previous/next frame controller (for media items).

structural_layers.description: Related peer entries from the same collection rendered in 3-card SSS-tier responsive grid with hover lift, status pill, and direct deep-links.

vehicles.stage_treatment: Tactical showroom presentation: subtle linear blueprint grid lines (background-image: radial-gradient + repeating grid), 2px glowing rim highlight on the vehicle silhouette, manufacturer badge prominently displayed above title, quick shortcut to '/compare?a=[id]&b='.
attribute_highlights: Top speed (Not verified in this atlas)

weapons.stage_treatment: Armory workbench canvas with dark carbon backdrop, high-contrast weapon preview, caliber/type specifications, and direct link to '/weapons/compare?a=[id]&b='.

characters.stage_treatment: Intimate protagonist/supporting portrait presentation with atmospheric duotone rim lighting, spoiler shroud for story premises, character affiliation tags, and partner links.

regions.stage_treatment: Panoramic vista viewport with latitude/longitude stylized watermark, landscape key tags (Coastal, Wetlands, City life), and connection to regional explore tools.

radio.stage_treatment: Soundstage broadcast layout with frequency/genre tags, clear honest disclaimer stating no audio stream is hosted, and reference attribution to GTA Town.

media.stage_treatment: High-fidelity photographic gallery frame with previous/next media navigator, uncompressed image download button, and frame index (e.g. 03 / 06).

videos.stage_treatment: Cinematic cinema frame with custom Rockstar poster overlay, pulsating coral/pink play trigger, embed iframe on click, and direct YouTube source link fallback.

guides.stage_treatment: Deep editorial layout with structured paragraphs, clean typography, verified source badges, and reading time indicator.

accessibility_and_contrast.apca_target: LC 75+ for all running body copy
accessibility_and_contrast.interactive_states: All buttons and links must provide visible :focus-visible with 2px --gta-turquoise or --gta-pink outline and 4px offset. No pure transparent containers.

motion_and_micro_interactions.stage_hover: Subtle scale up of imagery with cubic-bezier(.2,.65,.3,1) and glow expansion
motion_and_micro_interactions.action_buttons: Hover lift of -2px with box-shadow depth-raised, active depression of translateY(0)
motion_and_micro_interactions.reduced_motion: All transforms and scale effects disabled under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)

css_class_enhancements.dossier_stage: dossier-stage (encompasses both the media frame and the ambient background)
css_class_enhancements.dossier_badge_row: dossier-badge-row (tactical bar with kind, status, source label)
css_class_enhancements.dossier_grid: dossier-body-grid (asymmetric CSS grid with sticky technical sidebar)
css_class_enhancements.dossier_hud_card: dossier-hud-card (tactical bordered card with fine 1px edge stroke and ambient drop shadow)

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.file_structure: Update DetailPage.js and Portal.css to implement this comprehensive blueprint without breaking existing router paths, data schemas, or localStorage keys.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_mock_removal: Retain all canonical paths, local persistence hooks (saved, completed, spoilers), and component props exactly as defined in App.js.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.verification_step: Run yarn build or npm test after modifying files to ensure syntax and build stability.
